title: Check-in calls
subtitle: Asinu will call if you have not checked in after the allowed time.
settingsNotice: Feeling slightly unwell: call family members one at a time. Urgent support: call everyone in the Care Circle. Family members must enable notifications and have permission to receive alerts. Disabling this feature only cancels schedules that have not started; active alerts will continue.
errorTestIos: Could not create the CallKit test call.
testCallSent: The test call was sent to this device.
profileGalleryAccessibility: Open the check-in call interface gallery
statusConnectionUnavailable: Could not connect the call. You can still respond on this screen.
statusConnected: Connected. Please choose an option on the screen.
statusNoLiveKit: LiveKit is unavailable. You can still respond on this screen.
statusUrgentAccepted: You accepted the call. The other calls have stopped.
statusAcceptFailed: Could not accept the call. The response buttons are still available.
statusFamilyConfirmed: We recorded that you will take action. This does not confirm that your family member is safe.
statusFamilyUnavailable: No eligible family member could receive the alert.
statusConnectionLost: The call connection was lost; the response buttons are still available.
errorSendChoice: Could not send your choice. Please try again.
errorConfirm: Could not confirm. Please try again.
userInstruction: Listen to the prompt and choose an option.
familyUrgentDescription: Your family member needs help now. Seen does not mean someone has taken responsibility.
familyMildDescription: Your family member reported feeling slightly unwell. Seen does not mean someone has taken responsibility.
familyUnknownDescription: Asinu could not reach the user. Seen does not mean someone has taken responsibility.
safetyNote: Asinu provides reminders and notifications only. It is not an emergency response or diagnostic service.

result.userOkTitle: We recorded that you are okay
result.userOkMessage: Today's check-in is complete. Asinu will not contact your family.
result.mildTitle: We recorded that you feel slightly unwell
result.mildMessage: Asinu has started contacting your family members one at a time.
result.urgentMessage: Asinu is contacting all eligible family members at the same time.
result.familyConfirmedMessage: Asinu recorded that you will check on them. This does not confirm that your family member is safe.
result.familyUnavailableMessage: No eligible family member could receive the alert. Please review the Care Circle.
result.expiredMessage: No response was selected before the timeout. The system did not record that you are okay.

audio.userPrompt: Please choose an option. Press one if you are okay. Press two if you feel slightly unwell. Press three if you are in an urgent situation.
audio.userOk: Asinu recorded that you are okay. Thank you.
audio.userMild: Asinu recorded that you feel slightly unwell and will notify your family.
audio.userUrgent: Asinu recorded an urgent situation and is contacting your family.
audio.userRetry: Asinu did not receive your choice. Please choose one, two, or three on the screen.
audio.familyMild: Asinu reports that your family member feels slightly unwell. Please choose I will check on them.
audio.familyUrgent: Asinu has an urgent support alert. You accepted the call. Please open the app for details.
audio.familyUnknown: Asinu could not reach the user. Please choose I will check on them.
